senses.gloss:
Skandhyā^1, fem. plur., is used in the Atharvaveda^1 of a
disease ‘of the shoulders,’ probably tumours of some kind.
1) vi. 25, 3. Cf. Bloomfield, Hymns of the Atharvaveda, 472, 473.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Dhaval Patel on 20160113. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/189. note: Dh.
